[{"step":1,"file":"deps/mdnsd/tests/fuzz/fuzz_mdns_message.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":31,"var":"data,size","code":"memcpy(dataCopy, data, size);","note":"Attacker-controlled fuzz input is copied verbatim into a mutable buffer for parsing.","depends_on":[]},{"step":2,"file":"deps/mdnsd/tests/fuzz/fuzz_mdns_message.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":33,"var":"m","code":"bool success = message_parse(&m, dataCopy, size);","note":"The copied bytes are handed to the DNS message parser, making packet contents attacker-controlled.","depends_on":[{"on":1,"type":"data","via":"buffer contents"}]},{"step":3,"file":"deps/mdnsd/libmdnsd/1035.c","function":"message_parse","line":489,"var":"m->qd[i].name","code":"if (!_label(m, &buf, m->_bufEnd, &(m->qd[i].name))) {","note":"Question-name parsing stores decoded labels into the message's internal packet buffer and advances the write cursor.","depends_on":[{"on":2,"type":"data","via":"parsed packet"}]},{"step":4,"file":"deps/mdnsd/libmdnsd/1035.c","function":"_label","line":145,"var":"name","code":"memcpy(name, label + 1, labelLen);","note":"Each label length byte comes from attacker-controlled packet data and is copied into the fixed-size internal packet buffer without a sufficient upper-bound check on the destination cursor.","depends_on":[{"on":3,"type":"data","via":"label length and bytes"}]},{"step":5,"file":"deps/mdnsd/libmdnsd/1035.c","function":"_label","line":146,"var":"name[labelLen]","code":"name[labelLen] = '.';","note":"The parser writes a delimiter byte immediately after the copied label, so an oversized or repeated label sequence can drive a stack-buffer-overflow write past the end of m->_packet.","depends_on":[{"on":4,"type":"data","via":"destination cursor"}]}]
JSON
